s.how: Toss 600g chicken thighs in taco seasoning and grill for 12 minutes, then slice. Warm 12 tortillas and fill with chicken, shredded lettuce and salsa. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: the North Pole, home of the candy canes
s.how: Melt 300g white chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 6 crushed candy canes, chill for 30 minutes until set and snap into shards.

m.how: Rub a whole chicken with 30g butter and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Add 800g potatoes and 3 carrots to the tray for the last 50 minutes and rest before carving.

w.note: the elves at the North Pole
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill. Roll, cut into shapes and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with 250g icing sugar and a little water.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs and top with a swirl of whipped cream.
